purpose: Preserve complete Greek prose and six mode captions without counting musical-symbol tables as words.

jahn1882.citation: Aristidis Quintiliani De musica libri III, edited by Albert Jahn (Berlin: Calvary, 1882)

review.extent: All97 body leaves reviewed as contact sheets for large notation tables; pages82,87,90,91 then inspected at enlarged resolution. Every prose/caption crop boundary inspected separately.
review.finding: The only substantial musical-symbol tables occur on scans82,87,90,91. Page90 has its separate length-retry request. Pages82/91 contain prose above tables; page87 contains prose above and below six labeled mode diagrams. All six Greek mode captions are retained as separate textual crops. Letter-like music signs are preserved as explicitly nonlexical source-image regions.
review.policy: Retain the original whole-page OCR attempts, all symbols by source-image reference, and both fresh bounded model readings. Never invent prose readings from music signs or select a tied textual reading arbitrarily.
